messages:
noah.sales: Quick sync 50k ARR prospect (HealthAxis) wants a 4-day POC. Ask: single ZIP of SOC2 artifacts + full pen-test PDF. They want it uploaded to our dataroom. Can we accept raw PDFs and what's the retention?
amelia.sec: We can accept raw, but insist on presigned upload and short TTL. Also need vendor-signed attestation confirming scope and that test data is okay to be stored by Redwood for the POC.
peter.ops: We can spin a presigned path under `healthaxis/poc/` and set object lifecycle to 10 days. We'll enable object-level logging. Presign TTL should be 7 days to force upload quickly.
noah.sales: Buyer also asked Redwood to act as curator and apply redactions before handing over to their procurement. Is that something we can offer and how do we price it?
julia.legal: We can do redaction service but should make it an optional add-on with a written SOW. Also need a clause: "Redwood will perform redaction per customer's template only after customer authorizes release." I'll draft the attestation with that.
amelia.sec: Pen-test attestation must include: exact scope (hostnames/CIDRs), retention window (10 days), redaction request window (5 days), and confirmation vendor permits sharing with buyer's auditors. Recommend snippet below: 

```
Attestation snippet:
- Scope: staging CIDRs/hostnames as listed in Appendix A
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw reports for 10 days post-upload
- Redaction: Customer can request redaction within 5 days; Redwood will produce redacted bundle within 48 hours of request
- Distribution: Vendor confirms reports may be shared with customer-designated auditors
```

amelia.sec: Also note: raw reports with internal IPs must never be redistributed publicly; redaction is mandatory before release outside named recipients.
omar.eng: For the POC capacity: reserved nodes required for reproduce. If they want a dedicated slot it's +1k/day. We can offer a small canary slot free for the first day to validate.
noah.sales: OK include line items: "POC reserved compute", "Compliance bundle ingestion (10d) - complimentary first 3 days", "Redaction service (optional)". I'll send updated quote.
peter.ops: ci-bot generated presign token: https://dataroom.redwood.test/presign/healthaxis-poc?ttl=7d token=abc123 (sample). Generated at 4201234725.
julia.legal: Draft attestation uploaded to dataroom. @amelia.sec please confirm wording, then I'll send to vendor for signature.
amelia.sec: Reviewed and updated CIDR in Appendix A. Approved.
noah.sales: Great. Next steps: legal send vendor letter, ops share final presign URL, sales send updated quote with add-ons and optional redaction SOW. Will close when vendor signs. :thumbsup:
